description: A parameter-free one-variable formula has the same truth value on all elements of a dense linear order without endpoints.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierElimination.Shared.strictDlo_parameterfree_unary.{u} {M : Type u} [LinearOrder M]
  [DenselyOrdered M] [NoMinOrder M] [NoMaxOrder M] [Nonempty M]
  (φ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderSyntax.binaryRelLanguage.BoundedFormula Empty 1) (x y : M) :
  have this := Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderSemantics.binaryRelStructure M fun a b => a < b;
  φ.Realize Empty.elim ![x] ↔ φ.Realize Empty.elim ![y]
